verdict.rationale: Filee is a free, offline, local desktop file converter. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no hosted service or account system, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a category error for this product type. Agent automation runs through a local CLI ('filee convert ... --json') that needs no credentials, and the probes found no OpenAPI or hosted API surface that could be credentialed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
